basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming, renovated home with a desirable open floor plan and architectural detail throughout. The extra-wide living room features double-paned bay windows that provide abundant natural light, and the dining space flows seamlessly into the beautifully updated kitchen with skylight, Wolf range, and refaced cabinetry that walks out to the astounding, enormous, and multiple-level oasis garden. The garden has various seating areas encircled by mature succulents, fruit-bearing trees, and exquisite, lush greenery. The primary suite, with/ a renovated spa-like bath, is spacious, private, and wildly tranquil & also walks out directly to the garden. Oversized second bedroom overlooks palm-tree lined Dolores Street. 2 car side-by-side garage with laundry and storage complete the home. Located on a 2,672 sq ft deep lot with expansion potential. Sweet spot between Bernal & Glen Park & Noe Valley - 1 block to Church St, Mission St & Cortland Ave. Near 280 & 101, Muni, shuttle stops. A must see!
